name: context_attention
description: Packed prefill scaled dot-product attention with signature context_attention(q, k, v, b_start_loc, b_seq_len, max_input_len, is_causal). q, k, v are packed [total_tokens, num_heads, head_dim]; b_start_loc and b_seq_len are [B] integer offsets/lengths and max_input_len is a grid bound. For each sequence i, compute softmax(q[start:end] @ k[start:end].T / sqrt(head_dim)) @ v[start:end] with an optional per-sequence causal mask. Return a newly allocated float32 [total_tokens, num_heads, head_dim] tensor; inputs are not modified. The native grid uses max(max_input_len, max(b_seq_len)) so no query row is dropped. The suite exercises float32 inputs with head_dim 13/80/96/128, causal and non-causal modes, and up to 64 sequences.
